rules.title: Answer to Complaint
rules.description: Answer must be served within 20 days after service of process (FL Civ. R. 1.090)
rules.text: A defendant must serve and file an answer within 20 days after service of process.

rules.title: Motion to Dismiss
rules.description: Motion to dismiss for failure to state a claim (FL Civ. R. 1.140)
rules.text: A party may move to dismiss if the complaint fails to state a cause of action.

rules.title: Discovery - Interrogatories
rules.description: Response to interrogatories must be served within 30 days (FL Civ. R. 1.340)
rules.text: Responses to interrogatories must be served within 30 days after being served.

rules.title: Notice of Deposition
rules.description: Notice of deposition must be served at least 10 days before deposition (FL Civ. R. 1.350)
rules.text: A notice of deposition must be served at least 10 days before the deposition date.

localRules.title: Motion Practice
localRules.text: All motions require a statement of last known address and contact information.

deadlines.description: Answer filing deadline (20 days from service)
